labelPolicy.productIdentity: exact_known identity = the Commons category the file is filed under (brand + model family), cross-checked against the file title/description. Written by Commons contributors, independent of K Scan.
labelPolicy.visualReview: Subject confirmation, primary colour, subtype terms, brand legibility (brandVisible) and multi-item garment lists were annotated by the authoring agent from 300 px contact sheets. Marked agent_visual_review. An independent human pass is required before any holdout claim.
labelPolicy.rejection: Rejected when the subject is not the category item (signs, cars, crowds, logos only, giant replicas), when the item is too small to scan, or when an identifiable face dominates the frame.
labelPolicy.exactGranularity: Model family (e.g. Stan Smith, F-91W, Submariner). Colourway is not labelled; the judge does not test it.
